Since 0.1.17. The major version stays 0.

### Saves
Every library game now has Y › Saves. When RomM doesn't have a game's save yet, the page shows how to get it there as a checklist: an emulator Foldcade syncs, its setup, then the same file on RomM. If the game's emulator only launches games and doesn't sync, Y › Saves offers an installed emulator that does sync. It asks first, and says the old emulator keeps its saves. A game whose saves stay on this device no longer reads **No saves yet** or **Save checked**, and Set up saves never says **All set** while any do (#437).

The first time a game from one of your folders meets RomM, and RomM holds a different save, Foldcade stops before the launch places either one. **Choose save** shows both saves and places only the one you pick. **Play anyway** keeps what you play as a Backup on RomM (#437).

DroidDeck, GameNative, and Moonlight tiles have Y › Saves too, a read-only page that says where those saves live (#437).

### Apps
More apps on the Thor match the rest of the grid instead of showing their flat launcher icons:
- **LineageOS:** the Browser and AudioFX have their own objects. Calendar, Recorder, Gallery, and Music use the existing ones (#440).
- **Magisk and WG Tunnel** have their own objects (#441).
- **thor-features:** Fan profiles, Thor Screen Panel, Thor OLED Wash, and Thor Stick Cal have their own objects (#442).
- **Foldcade Thor and Foldcade Moonlight** have their own objects too. Foldcade Moonlight wears Moonlight's crescent in Foldcade's colours, so the two Moonlight tiles can be told apart (#442).

The release asset is `foldcade.apk`.

### Known issues
- The Thor hardware checklist is open. A green emulator run is not a Thor pass. https://github.com/predmore/foldcade/issues/43
- GameNative's own library is not imported. Foldcade reads Home shortcuts and exported `.steam`, `.epic`, `.gog`, `.amazon`, and `.pcgame` files. It does not read GameNative's private database. https://github.com/predmore/foldcade/issues/100
- Android games launched from Foldcade don't record play history, so they don't appear in Recent or Most played.
- On Android 17, Android's folder picker can't choose a folder under `Android/data`. Save sync for an emulator that keeps its saves there needs that emulator's data or save folder moved to shared storage first.
- If Android closes Azahar in the background to free memory, its tile can still say **Resume**. Android doesn't tell Foldcade. The next A restarts the game through the save check.
- ARMSX2's separate-card-per-game option is hidden from Foldcade, so games using it stay **Save folder not checked yet**.
- Foldcade doesn't yet tell PPSSPP which save folder to use. It checks where PPSSPP's saves land instead.
